sections.title: New features — verified on real frames

items.title: Auto-placement: talking head (top = before, bottom = after)
items.note: Captions now find the readable space beside her instead of hiding behind her; the HUD stays on screen with a leader line to her head.

items.title: Auto-placement: walk (before / after)
items.note: 'the neon rain' no longer vanishes behind her torso.

items.title: Wall tracking (OpenCV)
items.note: The quad drawn at frame 70 stays glued to the shutter while the camera moves (82/124 frames, mean confidence 0.88, 2.6 s). Drops at the frame edge.

items.title: Text on the wall, behind her
items.note: HOLD ON painted on the tracked shutter, occluded by her hair; HUD tag 'PERSON0 · F0090 · 0.94'. The test quad is narrow so the text is small — the hero will use a bigger wall.

items.title: Placing a surface in the editor
items.note: Click four corners on the paused frame, drag handles with a perspective grid, 'Place here' → tracked.

items.title: Make vertical: crop follows the subject
items.note: Smoothed virtual camera (≤0.4% of width per frame) keeps her centred; the text re-lays out for 9:16.

items.title: Vertical walk with re-laid-out text
items.note: Server-made 9:16 project rendered through the crop.

items.title: Edge shadow for behind words
items.note: LOUDER stays readable against the white shirt.
